quarantine_policy.coefficients: The two operation knots at n16 for each quarantined chi remain explicitly unavailable. Fit zero-state sampling independently if its controls and original timing/fit gates pass. Never extrapolate, bridge an invalid n knot, or interpolate across invalid chi knots.
quarantine_policy.selector_rule: Match candidate/width/chi and either kind=operation or allocation=entangled_sampling_transfer_diagnostic. Zero-state sampling is not matched.
quarantine_policy.skip_encoding: A skipped cell and all its scheduled slots remain in the allocation/terminal-status ledger as timing_status=not_started with the quarantine reason and empty times. They are not call_started or API attempt_result events and are never fabricated zero timings.

calibration_policy.coefficients: The two operation knots at n16 for each quarantined chi remain explicitly unavailable. Fit zero-state sampling independently if its controls and original timing/fit gates pass. Never extrapolate, bridge an invalid n knot, or interpolate across invalid chi knots.
calibration_policy.quarantine_selector_rule: Match candidate/width/chi and either kind=operation or allocation=entangled_sampling_transfer_diagnostic. Zero-state sampling is not matched.
calibration_policy.skip_encoding: A skipped cell and all its scheduled slots remain in the allocation/terminal-status ledger as timing_status=not_started with the quarantine reason and empty times. They are not call_started or API attempt_result events and are never fabricated zero timings.

resolved_contract.claim_boundary: Partial-domain local Maestro-style component adaptation; preparation quarantine was selected on disjoint untimed synthetic controls, not panel runtime labels. Full predictor matrix remains incomplete if these or other methods lack results. Width-control correction affects only a disjoint untimed API control; no calibration or panel timing from either failed run is reused.

deadline_policy.in_flight_rule: Complete an already started call up to its unchanged 180-second timeout, checkpoint it, then aggregate. Do not forcibly discard a valid completed call.
deadline_policy.incomplete_calibration: Retain its full allocation and partial evidence; do not promote a partially timed calibration or start the panel without completed enabled calibration and its original fitting/control gates. Report Maestro as partial/unavailable and continue report packaging.

conditions: Static identities and all immutable evidence pins verified
Real validator integration and regression tests pass
Ten- and twenty-cell calibration gates pass before expansion
Ten-panel-cell quality/timing gate passes before panel expansion
execution_authority.unsupported_dispatch_action: Fail before any native/timed call; this policy is not input for the unchanged v3 branch

panel_policy.error_comparison: Same candidate, configuration, selected C++ clock and row IDs; reduce repetitions within sessions then sessions. Bootstrap by source QASM hash with the existing seed registry. No pooled cross-engine ranking.
panel_policy.execution_rule: After successful enabled calibration/quality controls and accepted available/unavailable knot ledger, measure normalized executable panel cells even when prediction is unavailable. Validate the frozen ten-panel-cell pilot before expansion.
panel_policy.prediction_rule: A circuit needing a quarantined or otherwise invalid operation coefficient has no prediction. Zero-count operations do not require that coefficient. No interpolation over missing n16/chi32 or replacement using chi16, v2 coefficients, another simulator, mirror fidelity or sampled agreement.
panel_policy.quality_rule: Test actual panel amplitudes independently. A nonfinite/wrong-size/non-normalized candidate vector is quality_unavailable with its exact reason. A normalized finite vector below fidelity 0.99 is quality_failed. Retain any admissible completed timing diagnostically; neither state enters quality-qualified accuracy. Context/transport mismatch remains a global stop.
panel_policy.unstarted_rule: All unstarted members at cutoff remain explicit not_started; do not label them scientifically unsupported. Accuracy denominators list the exact predicted/timed/quality-qualified row IDs and full assigned coverage.

preparation_policy.quarantined_preflight: Record unavailable from pinned evidence; preserve raw norm/hash/context. Do not compute an accepted Schmidt rank from rescaled amplitudes or repeat this control to restore eligibility.
preparation_policy.remaining_preflight: Run one untimed rank/norm/context pass on each of the other 27 candidate width/configuration controls and the six exact Qiskit references. Validate actual rank records, not a mocked aggregate status. All enabled controls must pass unchanged base checks.
preparation_policy.unexpected_failure: Stop expansion, preserve the exact candidate/width/chi/QASM/numerical/context evidence and record a partial or failed run. Do not add exclusions or relax tolerance automatically.
preparation_policy.zero_sampling_preflight: Use the unchanged zero-gate sampling QASM with measurement on all wires for the untimed amplitude control at n16/chi4,8,32. Verify parsed width, full amplitude count, finite normalized amplitudes and zero-basis probability. Measurements preserve the exact zero state; no identity gate is introduced.

zero_state_control_policy.failure_evidence: Persist control QASM/hash, declared and parsed width, observed amplitude count/hash when available, norm, zero probability, actual worker context and transport result before stopping.
zero_state_control_policy.scope: Use the unchanged zero-sampling QASM for a separate untimed amplitude API control. Measuring the exact zero state is deterministic and preserves it. All declared wires participate in operations, preventing both max-index width inference and active-wire compaction. No gates are added, and no timed probe, panel QASM, cell ID or timing allocation changes.
